en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a formal garden courtyard with a long rectangular reflecting pool leading toward a pavilion in neo-Moorish style, flanked by crenellated walls and colonnaded wings with tall cypress trees. The printed caption at the top identifies it as a view from the Exposition Coloniale Internationale in Paris in 1931, and the bottom text specifies that this is the Moroccan Pavilion (Pavillon du Maroc), with architects credited at lower right.
